message: Hey friends! I recently found a great resource about preparing for power outages, and as a parent, I can say it’s super helpful to have a plan in place. Kids might see a blackout as an adventure, but it’s good to have some calming strategies ready so we can all enjoy the simplicity of candlelight and board games instead. What’s your go-to tip for keeping the kids entertained during a power outage? 🔦
